body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.
The target gains +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Ward
rider.html: Rite, 1 Echo: bind the target. Trigger: an enemy finishes voluntary movement adjacent to it. Echo: the protected creature may move 1 unit away without triggering that enemy's movement Reactions.
